title: RejectedClaim
description: One line of evidence/rejected/<run_id>.jsonl. Rejection is permanent: nothing here is patched, coerced or retried beyond the router's single retry. raw MUST be the post-scrub model output, never source text, because this file is committed to a public store repository.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document. Bump minor for an additive change, major for a breaking one.

reason.description: Human readable detail, for example the jsonschema error path and message.

raw.description: The post-scrub model output that was rejected. Never source text with PII.
